exposure: Pregnant women with COVID-19 without preeclampsia
Pregnant women with COVID-19 and preeclampsia
cohort: 19 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 infection
finding: COVID-19 in pregnancy presented with similar symptoms to the general population and did not appear to worsen maternal or fetal outcomes in this cohort.
mod_finding: 54.6% of women with COVID-19 underwent Caesarean section.
